issues.label: Special vs. general damages classification
issues.why: The court must correctly determine whether Yanling's sought damages are special (requiring computation) or general.

issues.label: Scope of NRCP 16.1(a)(1)(A)(iv) computation duty
issues.why: Determining what the disclosure rule requires and whether it applied to Yanling's claimed damages is central.

issues.label: Adequacy of Yanling's damages disclosure
issues.why: Whether any computation was ever properly disclosed or filed must be assessed.

issues.label: Diligence in providing computation
issues.why: The court found Yanling failed to act diligently, a factual and legal predicate for sanctions.

issues.label: Appropriateness of exclusion sanction
issues.why: Whether preclusion of evidence was justified under willfulness/harmlessness or lesser-sanction analysis.

issues.label: Dismissal with prejudice proportionality
issues.why: Dismissal is a severe sanction requiring consideration of factors and less drastic alternatives.

issues.label: Consideration of Young factors
issues.why: Nevada requires weighing enumerated factors before case-dispositive discovery sanctions.

issues.label: Whether any claim survives without special damages
issues.why: The court must decide if breach/unjust enrichment/conversion could proceed on other damages theories.

issues.label: Return of $200,000 investment as damages
issues.why: Whether recovery of the fixed initial investment is a computable, provable claim independent of special damages.

issues.label: Breach of contract elements for oral agreement
issues.why: The merits require assessing whether an enforceable unwritten joint venture contract existed.

issues.label: Statute of Frauds for real property venture
issues.why: An oral agreement concerning land/joint venture may implicate writing requirements.

issues.label: Existence and terms of joint venture
issues.why: Whether a joint venture was formed determines profit-sharing entitlement.

issues.label: Implied covenant claim viability
issues.why: Whether the good-faith covenant claim stands independent of the contract claim.

issues.label: Unjust enrichment as alternative theory
issues.why: This equitable claim may survive even absent a computed contract damages figure.

issues.label: Conversion of sale proceeds
issues.why: Whether retention of proceeds supports a conversion claim with ascertainable value.

issues.label: Effect of set-aside default on posture
issues.why: The prior default and its setting aside may bear on disclosure timelines and expectations.

issues.label: Timeliness of untimely supplemental computation
issues.why: Whether the late-filed supplement should be considered or excused.

issues.label: Failure to move for reconsideration
issues.why: Yanling's procedural choices may affect preservation of arguments.

issues.label: Notice and opportunity to cure
issues.why: Whether the one-week extension afforded adequate due process before dismissal.

issues.label: Prejudice to defendant from late disclosure
issues.why: Assessing harm to Yanhui is relevant to sanction severity.

issues.label: Expert testimony necessity for damages
issues.why: Whether damages required expert computation bears on diligence and the general/special distinction.
